description: This file implements platform-specific functions for retrieving a monotonic clock, including optimizations for x86_64 and AArch64 architectures, and fallback to POSIX clock_gettime. It defines functions for initializing and obtaining monotonic time, with conditional compilation based on architecture and platform.

methods.name: monotonicInit
methods.description: Initializes the monotonic clock based on platform and architecture, setting the function pointer accordingly.

methods.name: monotonicInfoString
methods.description: Returns a string describing the current monotonic clock implementation.

methods.name: monotonicGetType
methods.description: Returns the type of monotonic clock used (POSIX or hardware).
